If $ax^{2} + bx + c = 0\ and\ bx^{2} + cx + a = 0$ have a common
root and a, b, c are non-zero real numbers, then find value of
$\frac{a^{3} + b^{3} + c^{3}}{abc}$.
solution:
$\frac{x^{2}}{ab - c^{2}} = \frac{- x}{a^{2} - bc} = \frac{L}{ac - b^{2}}\ \ \ \lbrack\because One\ root\ common\rbrack$
$\Rightarrow x = \frac{bc - a^{2}}{ac - b^{2}} = \frac{c^{2} - ab}{a^{2} - bc}$
$\Rightarrow \left( c^{2} - ab \right)\left( ac - b^{2} \right) = \left( bc - a^{2} \right)\left( a^{2} - bc \right)$
$\Rightarrow a^{4} + ab^{3} + ac^{3} = 3a^{2}bc$
$\Rightarrow a\left( a^{3} + b^{3} + c^{3} \right) = 3a^{2}bc$
$\Rightarrow \frac{a^{3} + b^{3} + c^{3}}{3abc} = 1$
$\Rightarrow \frac{a^{3} + b^{3} + c^{3}}{abc} = 3$
